Container.Name: breakfix-triage
Container.Overview: Break-fix operations platform for NYC DOE device repair lifecycle management. Replaces a legacy Google Sheets + Apps Script workflow with a PostgreSQL-backed Next.js application. Requires a running breakfix-postgres container on the same Docker network. Database migrations run automatically on container start.
Container.Requires: The breakfix-postgres container must be running on the same "breakfix-net" Docker network. The DATABASE_URL variable below must match the credentials configured on breakfix-postgres.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: HTTP port the Next.js app listens on. Change the host side if 3000 is already used by another Unraid container.

Config.Name: DATABASE_URL
Config.Description: Full Postgres connection string. Use breakfix-postgres as the hostname (the container name on the breakfix-net network). Replace REPLACE_ME with the password you set on the postgres container.

Config.Name: NEXTAUTH_URL
Config.Description: URL the browser uses to reach this app. Use your Unraid tower IP (e.g. http://192.168.1.50:3000) until you put it behind a reverse proxy.

Config.Name: NEXTAUTH_SECRET
Config.Description: Random string used to sign session tokens. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32

Config.Name: ROUTE_OPTIMIZER
Config.Description: Route optimizer backend. Options: nearest-neighbor (default, no API key) or google-routes (Phase 4).

Config.Name: NOTIFICATION_TRANSPORT
Config.Description: Notification delivery transport. Options: stdout (default), smtp, gmail, apps-script.

Config.Name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: Google Workspace OAuth client ID (optional, for SSO in Phase 1).

Config.Name: GOOGLE_ROUTES_API_KEY
Config.Description: Google Routes API key (optional, for Phase 4 route optimization).
